name: What fire-rating requirements apply to attached garages?

mainEntity.name: What fire-rating requirements apply to attached garages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes require a fire-rated separation between an attached garage and the home living areas. Typically, this means installing 5/8-inch Type X fire-rated drywall on shared walls and ceilings, properly taped and sealed to block smoke and fumes. Any entry door leading into the living space must also be a solid-core or fire-rated door with a self-closing mechanism. During a remodel, our crew inspects the shared boundary, repairs damaged wall surfaces, and ensures all drywall and trim joints maintain proper fire-blocking integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shared walls and ceilings require 5/8-inch Type X fire-rated drywall, sealed joints, and a solid-core or fire-rated self-closing door into the home to prevent fire and fume spread.
